_schema: Hero banter lines — short personality dialogue triggered at battle events. Keyed by hero_id, then event_key. Optional by_chapter override: hero_id.by_chapter[chapter_id][event_key] takes precedence over default event_key when active chapter matches. Unmapped hero × event returns empty silently.
_events: battle_start — fired once per player chibi hero at battle init
player_kill — fired on the unit that landed killing blow (player side only)
low_hp — fired on the unit that dropped below ~30% HP
outcome_win — fired on each surviving player chibi hero at battle WIN
outcome_loss — fired on each player chibi hero at battle LOSS
_authoring_notes: Korean. Single short sentence per line (≤20 chars optimal). Voice contrast required across heroes — see character spec docs (design/art/characters/*.md) for personality anchors. by_chapter override (S18): chapter-specific variant for context-rich beats (ch01 도원결의 / ch05 신야 화공 / ch13 장사 / ch16 낙봉파). Override falls through to default when chapter unknown.
